attchmntText: Godawari Power And Ispat limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Godawari Power and Ispat Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 16th November 2026. Revenue rose 25% year-on-year to INR1,632 crores in Q2 and 29% to INR3,382 crores in H1. Profitability faced pressure from high iron ore and coal costs, with EBITDA and PAT margins at 12% and 5.2% respectively in Q2. The company revised FY27 iron ore mining guidance down to 2.5 million tons and pellet production to 3.5 million tons due to regulatory delays for overburden dumping. A 5 million ton beneficiation plant is targeted for Q3 FY27 commissioning. The CRM complex shifted to Maharashtra with a INR100 crore container line capex approved. Financial closure was achieved for a 20 gigawatt BESS project with INR2,795 crores in credit facilities. Steel melting shop capacity expanded to 5.75 lakh metric tons.

attchmntText: Godawari Power And Ispat limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Godawari Power and Ispat Limited has intimated that its management will participate in a physical one-on-one meeting with SKP Securities in Mumbai on Monday, 23rd November, 2026, from 4:30 PM to 5:30 PM. This interaction is pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during the meeting. Details of the interaction are available on the company website at www.godawaripowerispat.com. The notice also states that changes to the schedule may occur due to exigencies on the part of the organizer or the company.

attchmntText: Godawari Power And Ispat limited has informed the Exchange regarding receipt of regulatory permission allowing tree felling over an aggregate area of 60.84 hectares of land for dumping of overburden / mine refuse at Ari Dongri Iron Ore Mines.
voiceSummary: Godawari Power & Ispat Limited received regulatory permission from the Office of the Divisional Forest Officer, East Bhanupatrapur Forest Division, vide Letter No. 8677 dated 18.11.2026, allowing tree felling over an aggregate area of 60.84 hectares of land for dumping of overburden or mine refuse at its Ari Dongri Iron Ore Mines. The permission was received on 19.11.2026. The Company will undertake ground clearance activities in accordance with prescribed conditions, expected to be completed over the next 3 to 4 weeks. Following this, the Company expects to gradually increase its iron ore mining operations to a full capacity of 6 million tons per annum. This development is expected to facilitate the restoration of normal mining operations and ensure sustained availability of iron ore for the Company's captive requirements.

attchmntText: Godawari Power and Ispat limited has informed the Exchange about the Outcome of participation in the Avendus Spark INDX - Annual Investor Conference on 17.11.2026.
voiceSummary: Godawari Power and Ispat Limited participated in the Avendus Spark INDX Annual Investor Conference in Mumbai on 17th November 2026. attchmntText: Godawari Power And Ispat limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Godawari Power & Ispat Ltd. filed a revised investor presentation for Q2 and H1 FY27. Consolidated revenue grew 29% year-on-year to Rs. 3,382 crore in H1 FY27. However, profitability declined, with EBITDA falling 9% to Rs. 530 crore and PAT dropping 19% to Rs. 307 crore. EBITDA and PAT margins stood at 12% and 9% respectively. Management cited elevated input costs, including higher iron ore and coal prices, as reasons for margin pressure. The company expects margin recovery from Q4 FY27 following the commissioning of a 5.4 MnT beneficiation plant. Strategic updates include approval for a 20 GWh Battery Energy Storage System project and a 0.7 MnT CRM complex. Credit facilities aggregating Rs. 2,795 crore were sanctioned for the BESS project.
